SELECT s.id AS session_id, s.session_no AS session_no, s.tenant_code AS tenant_code, s.channel_id AS channel_id, s.customer_id AS customer_id, s.status AS status, s.agent_id AS agent_id, s.intent AS intent, s.emotion AS emotion, s.bot_transfer_reason AS bot_transfer_reason, s.source AS source, s.start_time AS start_time, s.end_time AS end_time, c.name AS customer_name, c.level AS customer_level, c.customer_no AS customer_no, lm.content AS last_content, lm.sender_type AS last_sender_type, lm.send_time AS last_time, COALESCE(mc.msg_count, 0) AS msg_count FROM session s LEFT JOIN customer c ON c.id = s.customer_id AND c.tenant_code = s.tenant_code AND c.is_deleted = FALSE LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT m.content, m.sender_type, m.send_time FROM session_message m WHERE m.tenant_code = s.tenant_code AND m.session_id = s.id AND m.is_deleted = FALSE ORDER BY m.send_time DESC, m.id DESC LIMIT 1 ) lm ON TRUE LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT COUNT(1) AS msg_count FROM session_message m2 WHERE m2.tenant_code = s.tenant_code AND m2.session_id = s.id AND m2.is_deleted = FALSE ) mc ON TRUE WHERE s.tenant_code = #{tenantCode} AND s.is_deleted = FALSE
AND s.agent_id = #{agentId} AND s.status = 3
AND s.agent_id IS NULL AND s.status IN (1, 2)
AND ( s.session_no ILIKE '%' || #{keyword}::text || '%' OR c.name ILIKE '%' || #{keyword}::text || '%' )
ORDER BY COALESCE(lm.send_time, s.start_time) DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT id, tenant_code, session_no, channel_id, customer_id, status, skill_group_id, agent_id, intent, emotion, bot_transfer_reason, source, start_time, end_time, csat_score, last_msg_seq, create_time, update_time, creator, editor, is_deleted FROM session WHERE tenant_code = #{tenantCode} AND channel_id = #{channelId} AND customer_id = #{customerId} AND status IN (1, 2, 3) AND is_deleted = FALSE ORDER BY start_time DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE session SET agent_id = #{agentId}, status = 3, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{sessionId} AND tenant_code = #{tenantCode} AND agent_id IS NULL AND status IN (1, 2) AND is_deleted = FALSE
mapper.select: UPDATE session SET last_msg_seq = last_msg_seq + 1, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE tenant_code = #{tenantCode} AND id = #{sessionId} AND is_deleted = FALSE RETURNING last_msg_seq

SELECT id, tenant_code, session_no, channel_id, customer_id, status, skill_group_id, agent_id, intent, emotion, bot_transfer_reason, source, start_time, end_time, csat_score, last_msg_seq, create_time, update_time, creator, editor, is_deleted FROM session WHERE tenant_code = #{tenantCode} AND agent_id IS NULL
AND status = 1 AND is_deleted = FALSE ORDER BY start_time LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT s.id AS session_id, s.tenant_code AS tenant_code, s.session_no AS session_no, s.agent_id AS agent_id, s.status AS session_status, m.id AS message_id, m.seq AS message_seq, m.content AS content, m.send_time AS send_time FROM session s JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT id, seq, content, send_time, sender_type FROM session_message WHERE session_id = s.id AND is_deleted = FALSE AND visible_to = 1 AND sender_type IN (1, 2) ORDER BY seq DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1 ) m ON TRUE WHERE s.is_deleted = FALSE AND s.status IN (1, 3) AND m.sender_type = 1 AND m.send_time <= #{oldest} ORDER BY m.send_time LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT s.id, s.tenant_code, s.session_no, s.channel_id, s.customer_id, s.status, s.skill_group_id, s.agent_id, s.intent, s.emotion, s.source, s.start_time, s.end_time, s.csat_score, s.last_msg_seq, s.create_time, s.update_time, s.creator, s.editor, s.is_deleted FROM session s WHERE s.tenant_code = #{tenantCode} AND s.status = 4 AND s.is_deleted = FALSE AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM qa_task t WHERE t.tenant_code = s.tenant_code AND t.session_id = s.id AND t.is_deleted = FALSE ) ORDER BY s.end_time DESC NULLS LAST, s.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT DISTINCT tenant_code FROM session WHERE agent_id IS NULL AND status IN (1, 2) AND is_deleted = FALSE

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM agent_status a WHERE a.tenant_code = #{tenantCode} AND a.is_deleted = FALSE AND a.is_connected = TRUE AND a.status = 1) AS online_agents, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM agent_status a WHERE a.tenant_code = #{tenantCode} AND a.is_deleted = FALSE AND a.is_connected = TRUE AND a.status <> 1) AS busy_agents, -- 「在线坐席 4/7」的分母：租户下已登记过状态的坐席总数（登录过长连接的都会有一条） (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM agent_status a WHERE a.tenant_code = #{tenantCode} AND a.is_deleted = FALSE) AS total_agents, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM session s WHERE s.tenant_code = #{tenantCode} AND s.is_deleted = FALSE AND s.status = 1) AS queuing_sessions, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM session s WHERE s.tenant_code = #{tenantCode} AND s.is_deleted = FALSE AND s.status IN (2, 3)) AS active_sessions, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM session s WHERE s.tenant_code = #{tenantCode} AND s.is_deleted = FALSE AND s.status = 2) AS bot_sessions

WITH today AS ( SELECT s.id, s.status, s.bot_transfer_reason, s.csat_score FROM session s WHERE s.tenant_code = #{tenantCode} AND s.is_deleted = FALSE AND s.start_time >= #{dayStart} AND s.start_time < #{now} ), msg AS ( SELECT COUNT(1) AS total, COUNT(1) FILTER (WHERE m.sender_type = 1) AS customer_total FROM session_message m WHERE m.tenant_code = #{tenantCode} AND m.is_deleted = FALSE AND m.send_time >= #{dayStart} AND m.send_time < #{now} ), csat AS ( SELECT COUNT(1) AS cnt, COUNT(1) FILTER (WHERE c.score >= 4) AS good_cnt, ROUND(AVG(c.score)::numeric, 2) AS score FROM csat_record c WHERE c.tenant_code = #{tenantCode} AND c.is_deleted = FALSE AND c.evaluate_time >= #{dayStart} ), -- 首次响应：客户最后一条 → 坐席第一条（只算对客户可见的回复） first_resp AS ( SELECT AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (fa.first_at - lc.last_at))) AS seconds FROM today t JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT MIN(m.send_time) AS first_at FROM session_message m WHERE m.tenant_code = #{tenantCode} AND m.session_id = t.id AND m.sender_type = 2 AND m.visible_to = 1 AND m.is_deleted = FALSE ) fa ON TRUE JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT MAX(m.send_time) AS last_at FROM session_message m WHERE m.tenant_code = #{tenantCode} AND m.session_id = t.id AND m.sender_type = 1 AND m.is_deleted = FALSE ) lc ON TRUE WHERE fa.first_at IS NOT NULL AND lc.last_at IS NOT NULL ) SELECT (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM today) AS session_today, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM today WHERE bot_transfer_reason IS NOT NULL OR status = 2) AS bot_session_today, (SELECT total FROM msg) AS message_today, (SELECT customer_total FROM msg) AS customer_message_today, (SELECT cnt FROM csat) AS csat_count_today, (SELECT good_cnt FROM csat) AS csat_good_today, (SELECT score FROM csat) AS csat_score_today, (SELECT COALESCE(ROUND(seconds)::INT, 0) FROM first_resp) AS first_response_seconds

SELECT COALESCE(ch.name, s.source, '未知渠道') AS name, COUNT(1) AS cnt FROM session s LEFT JOIN channel ch ON ch.id = s.channel_id WHERE s.tenant_code = #{tenantCode} AND s.is_deleted = FALSE AND s.start_time >= #{dayStart} AND s.start_time < #{now} GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 6

WITH today AS ( SELECT s.id, s.agent_id, s.csat_score FROM session s WHERE s.tenant_code = #{tenantCode} AND s.is_deleted = FALSE AND s.agent_id IS NOT NULL AND s.start_time >= #{dayStart} AND s.start_time < #{now} ), msg AS ( SELECT m.session_id, COUNT(1) FILTER (WHERE m.sender_type = 2) AS agent_msgs FROM session_message m WHERE m.tenant_code = #{tenantCode} AND m.is_deleted = FALSE AND m.send_time >= #{dayStart} GROUP BY m.session_id ), resp AS ( SELECT m.session_id, AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (m.send_time - prev.customer_at))) AS avg_seconds FROM session_message m JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT MAX(c.send_time) AS customer_at FROM session_message c WHERE c.tenant_code = m.tenant_code AND c.session_id = m.session_id AND c.sender_type = 1 AND c.is_deleted = FALSE AND c.send_time < m.send_time ) prev ON TRUE WHERE m.tenant_code = #{tenantCode} AND m.is_deleted = FALSE AND m.sender_type = 2 AND prev.customer_at IS NOT NULL GROUP BY m.session_id ) SELECT t.agent_id AS agent_id, COUNT(1) AS session_count, COALESCE(SUM(msg.agent_msgs), 0) AS message_count, COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(resp.avg_seconds))::INT, 0) AS avg_response_seconds, ROUND(AVG(t.csat_score)::numeric, 2) AS csat_score FROM today t LEFT JOIN msg ON msg.session_id = t.id LEFT JOIN resp ON resp.session_id = t.id GROUP BY t.agent_id ORDER BY session_count DESC, agent_id LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT DISTINCT tenant_code FROM session WHERE is_deleted = FALSE

WITH workload AS ( SELECT s.agent_id, COUNT(1) AS active_count FROM session s WHERE s.tenant_code = #{tenantCode} AND s.is_deleted = FALSE AND s.agent_id IS NOT NULL AND s.status IN (2, 3) GROUP BY s.agent_id ), today AS ( SELECT s.agent_id, COUNT(1) AS session_count, ROUND(AVG(s.csat_score)::numeric, 2) AS csat_score FROM session s WHERE s.tenant_code = #{tenantCode} AND s.is_deleted = FALSE AND s.agent_id IS NOT NULL AND s.start_time >= #{dayStart} AND s.start_time < #{now} GROUP BY s.agent_id ), -- 有人今天接待过、却没有状态行（比如刚入职没登录过长连接）：也要出现在卡片里， -- 否则会出现"明明有人接单，坐席实时状态却是空的" agents AS ( SELECT a.agent_id AS agent_id, a.status AS status, a.is_connected AS is_connected FROM agent_status a WHERE a.tenant_code = #{tenantCode} AND a.is_deleted = FALSE UNION SELECT t.agent_id, 0 AS status, FALSE AS is_connected FROM today t WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM agent_status a2 WHERE a2.tenant_code = #{tenantCode} AND a2.is_deleted = FALSE AND a2.agent_id = t.agent_id) ) SELECT ag.agent_id AS agent_id, ag.status AS status, ag.is_connected AS is_connected, COALESCE(w.active_count, 0) AS active_count, COALESCE(t.session_count, 0) AS session_count, t.csat_score AS csat_score FROM agents ag LEFT JOIN workload w ON w.agent_id = ag.agent_id LEFT JOIN today t ON t.agent_id = ag.agent_id ORDER BY COALESCE(t.session_count, 0) DESC, ag.agent_id LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT kind, event_time, event_text FROM ( SELECT 'session' AS kind, s.start_time AS event_time, COALESCE(NULLIF(c.name, ''), '访客') || ' 通过 ' || COALESCE(NULLIF(ch.name, ''), NULLIF(s.source, ''), '在线渠道') || ' 发起会话' AS event_text FROM session s LEFT JOIN customer c ON c.id = s.customer_id LEFT JOIN channel ch ON ch.id = s.channel_id WHERE s.tenant_code = #{tenantCode} AND s.is_deleted = FALSE AND s.start_time >= #{dayStart} AND s.start_time < #{now} UNION ALL SELECT 'transfer' AS kind, e.event_time AS event_time, COALESCE(NULLIF(c.name, ''), '访客') || ' 会话转人工' AS event_text FROM session_event e JOIN session s ON s.id = e.session_id LEFT JOIN customer c ON c.id = s.customer_id WHERE e.tenant_code = #{tenantCode} AND e.event_type = 6 AND e.event_time >= #{dayStart} AND e.event_time < #{now} UNION ALL SELECT 'csat' AS kind, cr.evaluate_time AS event_time, COALESCE(NULLIF(c.name, ''), '访客') || ' 评价 ' || cr.score || ' 星' AS event_text FROM csat_record cr JOIN session s ON s.id = cr.session_id LEFT JOIN customer c ON c.id = s.customer_id WHERE cr.tenant_code = #{tenantCode} AND cr.is_deleted = FALSE AND cr.evaluate_time >= #{dayStart} AND cr.evaluate_time < #{now} UNION ALL SELECT 'ticket' AS kind, t.create_time AS event_time, '新工单 ' || t.ticket_no || '：' || t.title AS event_text FROM ticket t WHERE t.tenant_code = #{tenantCode} AND t.is_deleted = FALSE AND t.ticket_type = 1 AND t.create_time >= #{dayStart} AND t.create_time < #{now} UNION ALL SELECT 'alert' AS kind, a.create_time AS event_time, '实时质检预警：' || a.rule_name AS event_text FROM qa_alert a WHERE a.tenant_code = #{tenantCode} AND a.is_deleted = FALSE AND a.create_time >= #{dayStart} AND a.create_time < #{now} ) feed ORDER BY event_time DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT s.session_no AS session_no, s.status AS status, s.channel_id AS channel_id, s.agent_id AS agent_id, s.intent AS intent, s.emotion AS emotion, s.bot_transfer_reason AS bot_transfer_reason, s.source AS source, s.start_time AS start_time, s.end_time AS end_time, s.csat_score AS csat_score, s.create_time AS create_time, ch.name AS channel_name, COALESCE(mc.msg_count, 0) AS msg_count, tk.ticket_no AS ticket_no, tk.ticket_status AS ticket_status FROM session s LEFT JOIN channel ch ON ch.id = s.channel_id LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT COUNT(1) AS msg_count FROM session_message m WHERE m.tenant_code = s.tenant_code AND m.session_id = s.id AND m.is_deleted = FALSE ) mc ON TRUE LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT t.ticket_no, t.status AS ticket_status FROM ticket t WHERE t.tenant_code = s.tenant_code AND t.session_no = s.session_no AND t.is_deleted = FALSE ORDER BY t.id DESC LIMIT 1 ) tk ON TRUE WHERE s.tenant_code = #{tenantCode} AND s.customer_id = #{customerId} AND s.is_deleted = FALSE ORDER BY s.create_time DESC, s.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT COUNT(1) AS total, COUNT(1) FILTER (WHERE c.create_time >= #{monthStart}) AS month_new, COUNT(1) FILTER (WHERE c.last_active >= #{activeSince}) AS active_7d, COUNT(1) FILTER (WHERE c.risk_level >= 2) AS risk_count, COUNT(1) FILTER (WHERE c.level >= 3) AS vip_count, COUNT(1) FILTER (WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM customer_tag t WHERE t.tenant_code = c.tenant_code AND t.customer_id = c.id AND t.is_deleted = FALSE )) AS tagged_count, COALESCE(SUM(c.total_value), 0) AS total_value FROM customer c WHERE c.tenant_code = #{tenantCode} AND c.is_deleted = FALSE

SELECT COUNT(1) AS session_count, COUNT(1) FILTER (WHERE s.intent ILIKE '%退款%' OR s.intent ILIKE '%退货%' OR s.intent ILIKE '%售后%') AS refund_sessions, COUNT(1) FILTER (WHERE s.intent ILIKE '%投诉%' OR s.emotion IN ('不满', '愤怒')) AS complaint_sessions, COUNT(1) FILTER (WHERE EXTRACT(HOUR FROM s.start_time) >= 22 OR EXTRACT(HOUR FROM s.start_time) < 6) AS night_sessions FROM session s WHERE s.tenant_code = #{tenantCode} AND s.customer_id = #{customerId} AND s.is_deleted = FALSE AND (CAST(#{windowDays} AS INTEGER) <= 0 OR s.start_time >= now() - make_interval(days => CAST(#{windowDays} AS INTEGER)))
